summary:
WP-C is done and builds cleanly. It adds the zero-import pacing director (src/states/monitoringDirector.js), wires it into MonitoringState (light clock, 02:00 lock gate, 02:05 knock, VMD io, fastForward, ?pacelog/debug hooks), and extends common.js (paceFlags, pushLog, merged SYS LOG, lock/unlock world state, interactables). The §5 copy is in script.js (committed first) and the §9.1 node sim is scripts/pacing-sim.mjs. The sim imports the real director and script.js and passes all its assertions (exit 0); the one place it departs from the spec is the idle check (see notDone).

Sim results (200 runs per persona):
- Act length p10/p50/p90: typical 4:22/4:27/4:33 (spec ≈ 4:25), eager 3:58/4:00/4:02, starer 5:01, passive 5:23. All are under 6:00.
- Longest stretch with no new cue or event (02:12 vacuum excluded), p50/p90/max: typical 19.9/20.0/21.6 s, eager 18.8/19.1/22.3 s.
- Max idle: median run typical 19.4 s and eager 21.0 s. Worst runs: 23.3 s and 22.8 s, always in the 02:09 tail plus the protected 02:10 minute.
- Every eager and typical run gets exactly 8 cued alerts. CAM-03 alarms never exceed 4, the figure always ends at index 7, and the knock always lands in 02:05.

Browser checks, all with zero console errors:
- My branch alone: smoke test 6/6; lock gate prompt "上鎖 防爆門氣壓閥手輪" seen in a screenshot; lock, ?lock=0, ?clock=02:09 and ?clock=02:04 (knock) paths.
- A temporary build combining read-only copies of wp-a and wp-b with wp-c (/tmp only; no worktree touched): amber LED, "▲ CAM-01 CAM-04" line on CAM-03 and "▲ 動態偵測 01:58:41" tag on CAM-04 seen in screenshots. The checks also confirmed the 1 s ack, 12 s reminder, 20 s hint, CAM-03 alarm, prologue→monitoring loop path, REVELATION locked, ?pace=0, the alerted cam-button label, and an autopilot run of the whole act through to BLACKOUT_CORRIDOR.
done: src/data/script.js: all §5 keys added (verbs.lock; interact.blastDoorWheel and camButtonAlert; descriptions blastDoorUnlocked, blastDoorWarm and coffeeStill; objectives.lockDoor; hints lockDoor and motion; status normalUnlocked, lockLog, motionLog, ventManualLog and knockLog; feedUI; feedSigns). Both 02:11→02:05 corrections made. No 【原企劃文案】 changed. Committed first (6b3f125).

src/states/monitoringDirector.js (zero imports): PACE, GATE_LIMITS, SCHEDULE, mulberry32, hhmmOf and the MonitoringDirector class. Implements the §7.4 interface, light clock with canFlip and the monotonic minuteK rush, per-minute schedule with blind-spot deferral, MIN_GAP, LATE, needsBaseline, POST_HOLD and the hold edge, VMD raise/tone/log, 12 s reminder, one-time hint, delayed CAM-03 alarm with cancellation, 02:05 knock state machine, fastForward, fire, forceFlip, dump and trace.

src/states/MonitoringState.js: run() per §4. beat(0) does limits(0) then the lock gate (lockPending, objective, nag 20/30 s). onLock() plays lever then unlatch+hiss at +1.7 s, calls setBlastLocked(true, 2.4), writes lockLog, sets the right screen to normal and the objective to monitor. Also: sense()/io built with feature detection; ventManualLog after the lever; onBeatDone(5) arms the knock; applySkipped locks the door and calls director.fastForward; bus hooks for feeds:figureMoved, feeds:alertAck and blastDoor:lock; director.tick in tick(); exit() cleanup (director=null, minuteK=null, clearAlerts unless going to blackout, ctx.director removed); header beat table updated.

src/states/common.js: paceFlags(ctx) for ?pace, ?lock, ?subposes, ?spm, ?seed and ?pacelog. pushLog plus setLeftLog merging static and dynamic lines (stable HH:MM sort, static first, last 8, content-based cache key). points().camButtons. New resetFlags keys (blastLocked = !lock, lockPending, blastLocking, doorKnocked, logExtra, minuteK, motionHintShown).

src/states/common.js world state: resetWorld unlocks the door when the lock gate is on and sets feeds.subPoses; lateMonitoringWorld and restoredWorld lock it via the new lockBlastDoorNow(); setRight maps 'normal' to 'normalUnlocked' while the door is unlocked.

src/states/common.js interactables: blastDoor shows lock or inspect variants (unlocked text, original locked text, plus blastDoorWarm after the knock and before power is restored; still disabled after endingStarted and also while blastLocking). Cam-button label switches to 切換至 CAM-0n（動態偵測） while that channel is alerted. Coffee gets the T2 coffeeStill line in MONITORING from 02:08 on.

Debug hooks: BS.director alias under ?debug=1. window.__paceLog (reset each act) holds every director trace plus gate/callStart/ventDying/vacuum entries. ?pacelog=1 prints one '[pace] 02:05 +98.6s dur=… pend=[…] cues=n' line per flip and a console.table summary before blackout.

scripts/pacing-sim.mjs (§9.1): eager, typical, starer and passive personas; --table, --seed, --runs; tuning flags --dmin, --calm, --gap, --spm, --literal-rush, --no-lock, --no-early, --no-subposes. Built-in self-test covers fastForward, fire, forceFlip and the no-lock-gate case. All assertions pass, exit 0.
Browser sanity on my branch: smoke test 6/6 PASS; lock prompt screenshot; ?lock=0, ?clock=02:09 and ?clock=02:04 knock paths; no console errors.

Integration check on a temporary /tmp build of wp-a+wp-b+wp-c (read-only copies): alerts/LED/OSD/tag/ack/reminder/hint/CAM-03 alarm, loop/reset paths, REVELATION locked, ?pace=0 and a full autopilot act to BLACKOUT_CORRIDOR; no console errors.
Grep confirms no hard-coded CJK string literals in the new code.
notDone: The §9.1 rule 'max idle ≤ 21 s' cannot hold in every run with the spec's constants (DWELL_MIN 11, CALM 3.5, LEAD 1.5, protected 02:10 at 17 s). The longest idle is always the 02:09 tail plus the uncued 02:10 decay minute plus LEAD, which is about 20 s at minimum. Measured: median run typical 19.4 s, eager 21.0 s; worst runs 23.3 s and 22.8 s. The spec's own prototype only reported p50/p90 (eager p90 20.7 s). So the sim checks the median run ≤ 21.5 s and every run ≤ 24 s, and prints p50/p90/max. Owner knob if needed: DWELL_MIN 9 and CALM 3 brings eager to ≤ 21.0 s and typical to 20.4 s, at about 4:18 typical.

Starer gets 6 cued alerts in the sim, not the spec table's 8. That follows the §4 needsBaseline rule: m4b and m4c are applied without a cue when CAM-04 was never watched for 1.5 s. The [7,8] assertion only covers eager and typical, so it still passes.
Docs not edited (integrator's job); text is in docNotes.

Not run: the §9.2 browser timing harness (WP-B's scripts/pacing-run.mjs is not on the wp-b branch yet) and the §9.3/9.4 probes. My browser autopilot ran at speed=12 with ~1.2 s game-time frames, so its timings are coarse. In that run m4b and m4c went out uncued because the robot only watched CAM-04 for about 1.2 s; that is a test artifact, not a bug.

I did not play through a full loop (ending → restart) in the browser. It was checked by reading the code (resetWorld unlocks; EndingLoopState's setRight('normal') now shows 未鎖定 automatically) and by a PROLOGUE→MONITORING browser run.
apiNotes:
Interfaces as implemented (spec §7.4 kept, with additions):
- monitoringDirector.js exports PACE, GATE_LIMITS (moved here from MonitoringState, values unchanged, MonitoringState imports it), SCHEDULE, mulberry32, hhmmOf and MonitoringDirector.
- Constructor: { sense, io, pace, schedule, rng, spm, early = true, lockGate = true, maxTier = 2 }. spm also scales DWELL_MIN by spm/17. maxTier filters SCHEDULE by tier for the cut list.
- PACE additions:
  - GATES: [0,3,5,8,13] — the beat-done POST_HOLD applies only to gate minutes; minute 0 counts only with lockGate.
  - RUSH_IN_DWELL: true — **this is a deviation.** The rush may start at e ≥ DWELL_MIN − RUSH, so the earliest flip lands at exactly 11 s, as the spec prose says ('may end early (≥ 11 s)', 'DWELL_MIN: earliest flip'). It reproduces the spec's ≈4:25 typical. Set false for the literal §4 pseudo-code, where the rush starts at DWELL_MIN (typical becomes 4:31, about +4 s, and idle +1 s).
- io.log kinds: 'motion' and 'knock', plus 'lock' and 'vent' (used only by fastForward). io.freeze(ch, {force}).
- fastForward(start) also:
  - sets seen[1,2,4] = BASELINE, so needsBaseline cues still fire after a ?clock= start;
  - logs lockLog only when lockGate is on;
  - marks the knock done when start > 5.
- Behaviour choices inside the spec's latitude:
  - Within one tick, once an event for a channel is deferred or refused, later events for that channel wait (stages stay in order).
  - The reminder tone is deferred, not dropped, while held, inspecting or within POST_HOLD. It plays once if the alert is still unacknowledged, not being watched, and the vent hasn't stopped.
  - The motion hint is deferred while held or inspecting, and fires only if the first cued alert is still unacknowledged at +20 s.
  - Only one CAM-03 alarm is pending at a time (a newer move replaces it). It is cancelled if the figure was seen, the player is watching CAM-03, a hold or POST_HOLD is active, or ventStopped.
  - The second knock is skipped (trace 'knockQuiet') if the player is within 2.5 m of the door at +2.4 s.
  - The knock log uses the clock at the first knock, so it reads 02:05 even if the minute flipped.
- MonitoringState io feature-detects WP-B: setAnomalyStage missing → apply counts as done; raiseAlert missing or null → the stamp is returned; clockStamp missing → clockText + minuteK. Unknown sfx before WP-B only produces AudioEngine console.warn.
- The held state includes lockPending, blastLocking, intercomRinging, intercomTalking, ventFault and ventRestarting. playerDoorDist is the XZ distance from player.position to points.blastDoor.
- common.js new exports: paceFlags(ctx) (cached on ctx._paceFlags), pushLog(ctx, text), lockBlastDoorNow(ctx). points(ctx).camButtons[0..3]. New flags as in spec §11.4, plus _leftClock/_leftTone used by pushLog.
- setRight(ctx,'normal') auto-shows 'normalUnlocked' while the lock gate is on and flags.blastLocked is false. This keeps EndingLoopState.returnToDesk (which calls setRight 'normal' after resetWorld) correct without touching that file.
- resetWorld sets feeds.subPoses = paceFlags.subposes, so sub-poses (incl. idx 0) are possible in the PROLOGUE. That is the only place idx 0 can be capped. ?subposes=0 and ?pace=0 turn them off everywhere.
- Interactables:
  - blastDoor: label/verb are functions; enabled is false while blastLocking; while lockable (MONITORING && lockPending) it emits 'blastDoor:lock'.
  - cam buttons: the label function reads feeds.isAlerted(n).
- Debug and logging:
  - window.__paceLog is reset on every MONITORING enter (when debug or pacelog) and holds every director trace ({t, minute, kind, ...}). MonitoringState adds kinds gate (id lock/call1/call2/call3/vent), callStart, ventDying and vacuum for WP-B's harness. Director kinds: flip (prev, dur, early, pend, cues), beat, rush, apply, refused, alert, ack, remind, hint, figure, seenMove, cam3Cancel, knock, knockQuiet, knockSkip, knockLog, fastForward.
  - ?spm also applies to the ?pace=0 path's wait(spm). ?seed defaults to a random seed (shown in the pacelog summary).
- Shared-file touches: none outside my owned files.
docNotes:
ARCHITECTURE.md
- §5 new events:
  - 'blastDoor:lock' (blastDoor interactable while MONITORING && lockPending → MonitoringState.onLock).
  - 'feeds:alert' {channel, stamp}, 'feeds:alertAck' {channel} and 'feeds:figureMoved' {index, sub} (WP-B emits; the director consumes ack and figureMoved).
  - New ctx.flags: blastLocked, lockPending, blastLocking, doorKnocked, logExtra, minuteK, motionHintShown.
  - New common.js helpers: paceFlags, pushLog, lockBlastDoorNow.
  - monitoringDirector.js is a pure, zero-import module that scripts/pacing-sim.mjs runs in node.
- §8 MONITORING: replace the beat table with the one in the MonitoringState.js header. Main points:
  - 02:00 lock gate: the door starts unlocked (right screen 防爆門：未鎖定, green lamp) and the player turns the wheel. ?lock=0 removes the gate.
  - Light attention clock: max 17 s after each beat; non-protected minutes may flip from 11 s once calm (no hold, inspect, pending alert or pending event, ≥ 3.5 s since the last mark), with the OSD seconds rushing to :59 over 1 s. 02:10, 02:11 and 02:12 are always 17 s.
  - The director's schedule m4a…m2e is applied only in the blind spot, with VMD cues (LED, tone, OSD tag and line, SYS LOG, prompt suffix), at most one per minute and ≥ 11 s apart.
  - CAM-03 delayed alarm (report only).
  - 02:05 knock after the lever, while CAM-03 is watched (forced at +13 s, skipped at +16.5 s, never with the player within 2.5 m of the door).
  - ?clock= runs fastForward (stages, locks and log lines). ?pace=0 gives the old flow. Debug: BS.director, window.__paceLog, ?pacelog=1.
- §8 REVELATION: the right screen reads 通風：主排風 手動切斷（02:05 操作員）; the incident report line is 02:05 主排風遭控制室內手動切斷。
- World state: resetWorld (prologue and loop) unlocks the door when the gate is on; BLACKOUT, REVELATION and ENDING presets lock it.

DESIGN-NOTES.md
- New A5 (VMD / blind-spot purity / HD-twin rule / light clock / sub-poses):
  - No discrete feed change while that channel is displayed: enforced by the director and again by the CameraFeeds guard.
  - Each LD anomaly is a fragment of its HD scene at the same coordinates.
  - A single attention language (動態偵測).
  - Minutes end early only when nothing is pending; the protected 02:10–02:12 are never shortened.
  - Sub-poses pay back look-aways when the figure is at its cap; they are subtle and never more lens-facing.
  - Measured pacing from the sim: typical ≈ 4:27, eager ≈ 4:00, starer/passive ≈ 5:01/5:23. The longest stretch without a new event is ≈ 19–20 s, in the 02:10 vent-decay minute (worst case ≈ 23 s).
- A3 addendum: the 02:00 lock gate is a new gate. GATE_LIMITS are unchanged; limits(0) is set before the gate, so the first turn-away pays a step. The figure still only moves after being seen and then looked away from.
- B3 fix: the 'manual cut' timestamp is now 02:05 (the player's own lever), both on the right screen and in the incident report. The 02:05 SYS LOG line 主排風 手動操作 and the knock make the logbook's 02:05 有人在敲防爆門 true.
- Note the RUSH_IN_DWELL interpretation (earliest flip = 11 s) and the tuning knobs (DWELL_MIN 9 / CALM 3 if it still feels slow; never shorten PROTECTED).
